Visitor replaces input with labeled output

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorInputCustom struct{
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}
func (v *testVisitorVisitorInputCustom) VisitInput(ctx htmd.NodeContext, inputType string, name *string, value *string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(fmt.Sprintf(`[INPUT:%s]`, inputType))
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorInputCustom{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<form><label>Username: <input type="text" name="username" value=""></label><label>Password: <input type="password" name="password"></label></form>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
